# <span id="aanchor141"></span> Hydrocarbon Property Time Frame Editor

The Hydrocarbon Property Time Frame Editor is where the Hydrocarbon Properties that have been created in FLOWCAL may be specified on a datetime effective, per-system basis. By default, all systems use the pre-set US Units 1972 configuration for all dates between 1/1/1972 00:00:00 and 1/1/2009 00:00:00, after which the pre-set US Units 2009 configuration is used. SI Units 2009 is also available if needed.

The dates for which each default configuration applies may be modified for each system, or custom configurations may be defined and named for any system and time frame as needed. The user can edit these values or create new records as new standards are published. New records may also be required if a contract calls for a value outside of the published standards, which needs to be used in calculations.

There are three ways to access the Hydrocarbon Property Time Frame Editor:

- When defining HC properties for an individual source, select **Tools** \> **HC Properties** from the Gas Quality Source Editor; or
- When defining HC properties for an individual meter, select **Tools** \> **HC Properties** from the Meter Editor; or
- When defining HC properties for the system, go to **Setup** \> **Source Analysis** \> **Hydrocarbon Properties** and select the **Tools** \> **System HC Properties** menu.

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Create New">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Create a New Record</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Create New">

<div class="procedure">

To create a record:

1.  Click **New** on the Hydrocarbon Property Time Frame Editor.
2.  Specify a Start/End Date and Hydrocarbon Property record.
3.  Click **Save**. Existing records will be shortened and removed as needed to accommodate the changes.

</div>

There are no gaps between time frames. A record is created in between non-adjacent time frames using the same set of units from the time frame preceding it.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Modify Existing">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Modify an Existing Time Frame</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Modify Existing">

<div class="procedure">

To modify a time frame:

1.  Select a row in the Hydrocarbon Property Time Frame Editor and click **Edit**.
2.  Adjust the Start/End Date and change the selected Hydrocarbon Properties as appropriate and click Save. Note that if the user shortens the time frame on either end, the editor will leave behind a record with the original entry so that there is not a point in time without an assigned Hydrocarbon Property record. Similarly, if the user extends a record, it will shorten and remove other records as needed.

</div>

There are no gaps between time frames. A record is created in between non-adjacent time frames using the same set of units from the time frame preceding it.

</div>
